They say know your place. We say you’ve found it right here.

For six decades, Flinders has challenged convention, backed people and changed lives – and we’re just getting started.

Founded in an era of bold ideas and social change, Flinders was created to think differently. Opening doors to education, tackling real-world problems and making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.

That independent spirit continues to define us today. From students and alumni to researchers, educators and partners, generations of the Flinders community have helped shape industries, advance knowledge and improve lives.

60 years is the foundation, not the finish line. Through Agenda 2035, Flinders has set a bold ambition to change 10 million lives for the better by 2035.
